Re-inventory current file blobs and required contexts, review each bounded batch, obtain real exact-head runs, retain rollback pins. A changed blob or unknown admission blocks the update.

After both scanner canaries and context inventory pass, remove only the redundant Supplemental secret checks workflow and its scope row. Retain detector code, negative controls and differential tests.
Requery both names including private/nondefault callers; document intentional historical references. Test compatibility sources before archival; do not delete historical pinned code.
